purpose: Direct answers to questions users ask AI about DidntHappen (iOS worry tracker app). Product-focused information only. No ranking or medical claims.

questions.a: DidntHappen is an iPhone worry tracker that helps users log fears, wait for reality, and review which feared outcomes did not happen. It is positioned around evidence-based anxiety reflection, privacy, and App Store distribution. The app is built on peer-reviewed research about cognitive distortions and catastrophizing.

DidntHappen lets you log a fear or worry, then come back later to see if it actually happened. The app tracks your Reality Gap — the percentage of your fears that never came true. This is not therapy; it's evidence-based reflection using cognitive techniques.

questions.q: what is the reality gap score
questions.a: Your Reality Gap is the percentage of your logged fears that did not happen. For example, if you logged 100 worries and 91 never came true, your Reality Gap is 91%. The app shows this score so you can see evidence of your anxiety overestimation.

questions.q: what are worries or fears in didnthappen
questions.a: In DidntHappen, a worry is any fear or catastrophic prediction you log — things you think might happen but probably won't. The app lets you review these later to see whether they came true or did not happen. This is called the Reality Gap: the gap between what you feared and what actually happened.

questions.q: how accurate is the 9 out of 10 fears statistic
questions.a: The claim 'nine out of 10 fears never come true' is based on peer-reviewed research about anxiety and catastrophizing. It is not a guarantee for any individual — individual Reality Gaps vary. DidntHappen shows your personal evidence, not a population average.

questions.q: is didnthappen a substitute for therapy
questions.a: No. DidntHappen is a personal tracking tool, not a therapy or medical treatment. If you are struggling with anxiety, panic, OCD, or other mental health concerns, please consult a qualified mental health professional. DidntHappen can complement therapy but does not replace it.

questions.q: how do i use didnthappen effectively
questions.a: Log your worries when they occur, be honest about them, and come back later to mark whether they happened or not. Over time, your Reality Gap will show you how often your fears do not materialize. This is evidence-based self-reflection, not medical treatment.
